title: bug: the JetBrains board shows a ▶ (move forward) on BLOCKED cards in the Working column that does nothing, because TaskColumn passes onNext to every card and getNextStatus("BLOCKED") is null (onPrevious is already filtered by BoardMoves.hasPrevious)
description:
Held-back finding from defect hunt #4 (task-130a6a5c, architect-1dd28c7c, msg-eea862e7). It was held until task-0f2e958f, which shared MoeToolWindowPanel.kt, was DONE (17:41Z). The governor re-checked it at moe/work-2026-10-24 ff652048 at 17:42Z on 2026-11-03.

PROBLEM (moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/):
- MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:665 gives every column except Done `onNext = { task -> handleNext(task) }`. BLOCKED is display-mapped into the Working column.
- board/TaskColumn.kt:175 passes `onNext = onNext` to every TaskCard unfiltered. The sibling onPrevious is filtered per card: `onPrevious?.takeIf { BoardMoves.hasPrevious(task.status) }`.
- board/TaskCard.kt:266-275 renders the ▶ label whenever onNext != null.
- handleNext (MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:538-545) starts with `getNextStatus(task.status) ?: return`. getNextStatus (:533-536) indexes workflowOrder, which has no "BLOCKED", so it returns null.
- So a BLOCKED card offers a ▶ that silently does nothing. The board's way out of BLOCKED is unblock_worker resolveBlocks / set_task_status, not a forward move.

FIX DIRECTION (the planner decides): filter onNext per card the way onPrevious is filtered, e.g. a BoardMoves.hasNext(status) that is false for DONE and BLOCKED (and any status getNextStatus maps to null), used at TaskColumn.kt:175. Keep the AWAITING_APPROVAL ▶, which routes to BoardApproval.approveRendered. Add JUnit 4 cases to the existing BoardMovesTest.kt. Note: BoardMovesTest.kt:13 still copies an old transition table (BACKLOG without REVIEW); fix that only if the new cases depend on it.

Narrow row: the JetBrains gate is `gradlew.bat test` under the jetbrains-gradle lease, labelled Windows. No daemon or launcher suite. epic-be924fb8 isEpicFinal is the max-order fallback (ruling msg-bbf4f109).
definitionOfDone: A BLOCKED card (and any card whose status has no forward move) renders no ▶. Cards in BACKLOG, PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, WORKING and REVIEW keep their ▶ and current behavior.

A JUnit 4 test in moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/ pins the per-status forward-move predicate, including BLOCKED and DONE returning false. It fails on ff652048 or does not compile there (RED evidence in a task comment).
`gradlew.bat test` passes under the jetbrains-gradle lease (Windows), with the command and output tail in the completion evidence.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 1. Main-source edits only, with the Edit tool.

(a) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/BoardMoves.kt: insert after hasPrevious (:27), inside the object:

```
/**
 * The status the board's Next (right arrow / detail-dialog Next) moves [status] to, or null when there is
 * none. Workflow order BACKLOG, PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, WORKING, REVIEW, DONE; each target is in the
 * daemon's VALID_TRANSITIONS (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts), and AWAITING_APPROVAL reaches
 * WORKING through BoardApproval.approveRendered. DONE is the end, BLOCKED leaves only through unblock_worker
 * resolveBlocks or set_task_status, and ARCHIVED or unknown statuses have no forward move. Never throws.
 */
fun next(status: String): String? = when (status) {
    "BACKLOG" -> "PLANNING"
    "PLANNING" -> "AWAITING_APPROVAL"
    "AWAITING_APPROVAL" -> "WORKING"
    "WORKING" -> "REVIEW"
    "REVIEW" -> "DONE"
    else -> null
}

fun hasNext(status: String): Boolean = next(status) != null
```

(b) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt. It is in the same package, so add no import.
- Delete the local `val workflowOrder` and `fun getNextStatus` (:532-536), plus the blank line after them.
- handleNext's first line (:539) becomes `val nextStatus = BoardMoves.next(task.status) ?: return`.
- The detail dialog's callback (:626) becomes `val nextCb = if (BoardMoves.hasNext(task.status)) { t: Task -> handleNext(t) } else null`, mirroring prevCb on the next line.
- Keep handleNext's AWAITING_APPROVAL → BoardApproval.approveRendered branch and `onNext = if (!isDone) ...` (:665) as they are.

(c) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/board/TaskColumn.kt:175: change `onNext = onNext` to `onNext = onNext?.takeIf { BoardMoves.hasNext(task.status) }`, exactly as onPrevious is filtered on the same line. BoardMoves is already imported at :5.

Why this preserves behavior: next(s) returns what getNextStatus(s) returned for every s. That is the next status in order for BACKLOG..REVIEW, and null for DONE (last index), BLOCKED, ARCHIVED and unknown (index -1). So the dialog's Next and handleNext's targets are unchanged. The only visible change is that a card whose status has no forward move (BLOCKED, display-mapped into the Working column) no longer gets the ▶. A BLOCKED card already has no ◀, so TaskCard.kt:280 then adds no arrow panel at all. Do not edit TaskCard.kt.

The error handling stays as it was. next() never throws, since unknown statuses map to null. The ▶ click stays wrapped in TaskCard's safeCallback, and handleNext keeps its `?: return` guard.

DoD 3: verification. Run it ONCE, fresh, from the task worktree root, after every edit is in. Its output is the evidence you give complete_task, and QA re-runs the same command.

1. moe.acquire_resource { resourceId: "jetbrains-gradle", taskId, workerId }.
2. Run checkRef 1 exactly: `cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d $(wslpath -w "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)")\\moe-jetbrains && gradlew.bat test --rerun"`. gradlew.bat lives in moe-jetbrains/, not the repo root (mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box §2c).
3. moe.release_resource immediately afterwards, even on failure.
4. Run checkRefs 2-5. Each must exit 0:
   - 2 prints the test-results XML totals (tests > 0, 0 failures, 0 errors) and requires both new cases in TEST-com.moe.toolwindow.BoardMovesTest.xml.
   - 3 is the static RED check.
   - 4 checks the card/panel wiring.
   - 5 checks scope: only the 4 plan files differ from the merge base, and there are no untracked files.

complete_task evidence:
- verification.command = checkRef 1 verbatim
- exitCode = 0
- outputTail = the BUILD SUCCESSFUL tail plus checkRef 2's totals line

The error handling for a red run:
- A red exit with a truncated tail can be the Gradle IPC flake. Check the Windows Gradle daemon log (%USERPROFILE%\.gradle\daemon\<ver>\daemon-<pid>.out.log) for MessageIOException before believing it, then re-run once (§2).

- Never hand in a `> Task :test UP-TO-DATE` run (§1).
- The `Exception in thread "cleanup" java.lang.OutOfMemoryError` line from JansiLoader is noise (§3).

Adversarial self-review, once. Load the adversarial-self-review skill, then read this task's diff (`git diff $(git merge-base HEAD moe/work-2026-10-24)`) as an attacker. Check each item:
(1) `grep -rnE 'workflowOrder|getNextStatus' moe-jetbrains/src` finds nothing. The card ▶, the detail dialog's Next and handleNext all go through BoardMoves.
(2) For each status, compare the old getNextStatus with BoardMoves.next, including "" and lowercase "working" (both null before and after). BACKLOG, PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, WORKING and REVIEW cards keep the ▶ and the same target. AWAITING_APPROVAL still approves through BoardApproval.approveRendered.
(3) Re-read VALID_TRANSITIONS in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts at the current tip. Every non-null next target must be legal from its source status.
(4) Mutation check: next("AWAITING_APPROVAL") = null, or next("BLOCKED") = "WORKING", must each fail one of the new tests.
(5) Stale input: a card rendered as WORKING whose task turns BLOCKED before the click still sends WORKING's move, from its stale Task object. That is pre-existing, and the next state snapshot re-renders the card. Note it in the completion summary; do not widen scope.
(6) No added line contains a project.json globalRails.forbiddenPatterns string. TaskCard.kt, TaskDetailDialog.kt and the validTransitions copy in BoardMovesTest.kt are unchanged, and checkRef 5 still exits 0.
Fix anything you find inside the 4 plan files only. If a file changed, re-run step 3.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: On the JetBrains board, a card shows the ▶ (move forward) only when its status has a forward move. BACKLOG, PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, WORKING and REVIEW cards keep their ▶ and exactly their ff652048 behavior; AWAITING_APPROVAL approves through BoardApproval.approveRendered. BLOCKED, DONE, ARCHIVED and unknown statuses render none. The forward move lives in one pure helper, BoardMoves.next/hasNext, and the card ▶ filter, the detail dialog's Next and handleNext all use it.
acceptanceCriteria: A BLOCKED card in the Working column renders no ▶ (and so no empty arrow panel). BACKLOG/PLANNING/AWAITING_APPROVAL/WORKING/REVIEW cards keep the ▶ with unchanged targets.

BoardMovesTest gains nextFollowsTheWorkflowOrder and doneBlockedArchivedAndUnknownHaveNoNext. They reference BoardMoves.next/hasNext, which ff652048 lacks, so they do not compile there. The RED run's unresolved-reference lines are in a task comment.

`gradlew.bat test --rerun` (from moe-jetbrains/) passes under the jetbrains-gradle lease. The XML totals show tests > 0, 0 failures and 0 errors, and TEST-com.moe.toolwindow.BoardMovesTest.xml lists both new cases.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Three alternatives were rejected:
(a) A hasNext in TaskColumn that wraps the panel's getNextStatus. That function is local to the panel's board builder, so neither TaskColumn nor a test can reach it, and two copies of the order would drift.
(b) Hiding the ▶ inside TaskCard by status. TaskCard takes callbacks, and the sibling onPrevious is already filtered in TaskColumn, so the fix belongs there too.
(c) Giving BLOCKED a forward action such as unblock. That is out of scope: the row asks only that the ▶ be absent, and the way out of BLOCKED stays unblock_worker resolveBlocks or set_task_status.
